# Introduction {.unnumbered}

Welcome to the website for BAN430 Forecasting. We will use this website as a supplement to lectures. The website is an ongoing development, so not all subjects will have content yet. Below you will find a detailed (preliminary) lecture plan, link to the textbook and curriculum.

## Lecture plan

```{r lecturePlan, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
options(knitr.kable.NA = '')
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
# kableExtra's kePrint.js dependency needs jQuery, which Quarto's Bootstrap 5
# template doesn't load by default - without this, kePrint.js throws
# "$ is not defined" in the browser console on this page.
htmltools::tagList(rmarkdown::html_dependency_jquery())
df <- readxl::read_excel("lecturePlan.xlsx", sheet = "h2026",
                           col_types= rep("text",3))[,-1]

n <- nrow(df)
date_rows  <- seq(1, n - 2, by = 2)
topic_rows <- seq(2, n - 1, by = 2)
exam_row   <- n

df %>%
  kbl(align = "c") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "bordered"),
                full_width = TRUE,
                fixed_thead = TRUE,
                font_size = 15) %>%
  row_spec(0, background = "#00395A", color = "white", bold = TRUE,
           extra_css = "padding: 10px;") %>%
  row_spec(date_rows, background = "#00395A", color = "white", bold = TRUE,
           extra_css = "padding: 8px;") %>%
  row_spec(topic_rows, background = "#F4F6F7", color = "#1a1a1a",
           extra_css = "padding: 8px;") %>%
  row_spec(exam_row, background = "#8B1E1E", color = "white", bold = TRUE,
           extra_css = "padding: 8px;")

```

We will use the textbook *Forecasting: Principles and Practice*, 3rd edition, by Hyndman and Athanasopoulos, i.e. the online version which can be accessed at <https://otexts.com/fpp3/>.

## Curriculum

Textbook Hyndman and Athanasopoulos(2021) chapters 1-10 and 13. Additional notes by lecturer on volatility forecasting. All the material on this website.
